---
name: 🚀 Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or improvements for the HA TV Dashbord (Android TV) app.
title: '[Feature]: '
labels: ['enhancement']
assignees: ''
---

### Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. (e.g., "I'm frustrated when trying to navigate to...")

### Describe the solution you'd like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Keep the Android TV 10-foot UI experience in mind.

### Describe alternatives you've considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered to solve this problem.

### Additional Context
Add any architectural notes, mockup designs, screenshots, or examples from other Android TV apps that show how this might look or function.
